request.title: PTEN evidence investigation
request.question: Investigate preserved abundance with reduced activity among these PTEN substitutions. Delegate independent assay-context and structure reviews. Inspect identity, comparability, declared filtering and mapping. Record a revision when actual source or coordinate limitations narrow the plan, reconcile the branches, and finalize a brief with checked evidence. Stay within 20 model calls: use scoped workers with at most two tools each. Do not make causal or clinical claims.
